title: Nemzetpolitika és a határon túli magyarság (Kin-State Policy & Cross-Border Hungarians)
grammar: Constitutional Guarantees, Supranational Integration & Kin-State Registers in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians living outside the borders.
I can explain the simplified naturalisation of 2010 in a few words.
I can say what the Day of National Cohesion is.
I can use the words of this lesson about Hungarians abroad.
